GAP: the outcome row 'the stream block logs nothing (stream_access_log off)' is uncovered with a false reason. It says the stream block exists only when another class declares a stream server and a variant cannot reach it; but puppet-nginx 8.4.0 renders the stream block (templates/conf.d/nginx.conf.erb:405-421, including access_log <stream_access_log>) whenever class nginx's stream param is true (init.pp:325, Boolean $stream = false), and nginx_base passes my_configs straight to class nginx. Production enables it exactly that way: the nginx_frontend_mail fixture for nginx_base sets my_configs {stream: true}. So a variant of this set with my_configs {stream: true} (plus libnginx-mod-stream, which this set already installs in a mutating check) on the active ubuntu node can show the stream block with access_log off and nginx -t passing. The cited nginx_frontend_mail PASS shows the lab can exercise it, not that it lacks anything, so the row's lifted_by capability is not missing.
